sourceImages.prompt: Edit this background only. Preserve its beautiful ornate matte screen-print botanical illustration style, exact landscape layout and quiet dark lower-right quote area. CRITICAL CHANGE: SWAP the apple order and the overall color order. The LEFT apple must be a bright fresh GREEN APPLE (Japanese ao-ringo means GREEN, never blue), the RIGHT apple must be a RED APPLE. Exactly two dominant apples, equally large and clear. Left frame and left broad diagonal color field must be GREEN; right apple and right frame/color field RED. Match character hair whose left is green/right red. Both dominant apples should be a little smaller and higher, with whole recognizable silhouettes in the top 30% of image above the future diagonal name ribbon. Remove ALL pointed ornamental diamond/star crests between apples; use plain round botanical flourishes or leaves instead. No sparkle stars, no stars, no pointed shine mark, no lettering, no humans, no text. Do not insert a name ribbon.

This is a purpose-designed professional motion graphics / screen-print poster background, NOT a generic wallpaper, NOT a UI icon sheet. Flat 2D design, sophisticated Japanese game art direction, 4-5 harmonious ink colors with a near-black charcoal anchor, matte silkscreen texture. Supporting subtle motifs/texture may flow around edges and behind left portrait. Full bleed, vibrant distinctive left color field and a beautifully composed upper-right hero graphic, dark bottom-right. Produce BACKGROUND ONLY: no humans, no anime person, no name, no words, no letterforms, no numbers, no text, no brand, no logo, no watermark. Absolutely NO sparkle stars, NO four-point shine symbols, NO generic starburst watermarks. Do not draw the cream name ribbon: it is composited later.
